scientific_question: Do the constituent ecological routes recur across systems?
minimum_information: primary-source route coding grouped by biological independence cluster
what_the_method_explains: biological recurrence of the four constituent route families
current_bita_evidence: 56 records; 25 clusters; A-to-pollination 5; A-to-antagonism 8; D-to-antagonism 18; D-to-pollination 10
does_not_explain: natural prevalence or any channel interaction

scientific_question: Is joint selection on A and D non-additive?
minimum_information: one declared A contrast crossed with one declared D contrast on a common outcome
current_bita_evidence: Kessler 2008 supplies a manipulated two-by-two reproductive surface and registered aggregate enumeration preserves a positive sign across all declared profiles; source-design uncertainty remains unavailable; Impatiens observational intervals cross zero
does_not_explain: which ecological channel generated the total interaction or whether the source-design interval is wholly above zero
next_valid_gate: recover Kessler source uncertainty or an independent manipulated factorial with complete uncertainty

scientific_question: Which mechanism allocations are compatible with an observed total interaction?
minimum_information: observed delta plus declared channel orientation
what_the_method_explains: the set I(delta) of rho-iota-kappa allocations compatible with delta
does_not_explain: a unique realized mechanism or a probability distribution over mechanisms

scientific_question: Can the biotic balance be bounded before point identification?
minimum_information: observed Delta_AD_W plus an explicit bound on kappa_delta
current_bita_evidence: kappa_delta greater-than-or-equal-to zero implies rho_delta-minus-iota_delta greater-than-or-equal-to Delta_AD_W
does_not_explain: separate rho_delta and iota_delta values or universal non-negative joint cost
next_valid_gate: bounded cost assay or one selective channel estimate

scientific_question: How far do existing studies reach toward mechanism allocation?
minimum_information: predeclared coding of trait factorial consumer factorial baseline separability and joint-cost dimensions
what_the_method_explains: fragmented identification frontier and study-specific minimum augmentations
current_bita_evidence: trait-factorial consumer-factorial randomized-context and selective-defence information occur in complementary studies
does_not_explain: literature prevalence or proof that no qualifying study exists outside the screened set
next_valid_gate: systematic prevalence review or study-specific augmentation

scientific_question: Can antagonist relief and pollinator interference be point-identified?
minimum_information: selective consumer toggles common A-D coordinates and measured or justified pollinator-absent baseline
what_the_method_explains: rho_delta and iota_delta on the declared scale
current_bita_evidence: no screened system closes all required dimensions
does_not_explain: valid channel values when interventions are non-selective or coordinates drift
next_valid_gate: execute the crossed design in a biologically selective system

what_the_method_explains: whether apparent pollinator-dependence and antagonist-dependence are one common coupling contrast
current_bita_evidence: identity established theoretically but not tested in a complete screened system

scientific_question: Can the unallocated residual be interpreted as joint cost?
method: independent A-by-D cost or allocation assay
minimum_information: an assay independent of the reproductive residual with sign and scale comparability
what_the_method_explains: whether residual sign or magnitude agrees with a measured joint channel
current_bita_evidence: no strict independent joint-cost estimate recovered
does_not_explain: unmeasured means unidentified; residual is not automatically construction cost
